features.notes: Added safeCallbackPath as a fail-closed same-origin absolute-path helper. It rejects protocol-relative and parser-normalized backslash escapes, leading/trailing whitespace and controls, malformed percent encoding, and recursively decoded escapes; legal paths are returned byte-for-byte. Login now passes callbackUrl through the helper. The focused test table covers 17 attack vectors, 3 legal paths, malformed encoding, controls, nested encoding, and omitted/empty values. Final direct Node TypeScript-loader smoke passed all 22 unsafe and 3 legal vectors; git diff --check passed. npm run lint exited 127 (next missing), npm run verify exited 127 (prisma missing), and npm run test -- tests/shared/url.test.ts exited 127 (vitest missing) before executing project checks.
